name: pilot
note: C0 pilot slice (~20 tasks, 5/domain) to validate the harness end-to-end. Not the published corpus. Ground-truth is deterministic where possible so the pipeline can be checked without a judge.

tasks.prompt: What is the output of [1,2,3,4].reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) in JavaScript? Give only the number.
Convert this to a JSON object with age as a number: name=Alice, age=30. Output only the JSON.
Write a SQL query that selects the name column of rows in a table users(name, age) where age is greater than 30.
Write a JavaScript function expression (no name) that takes an array of numbers and returns their sum.
What shell command lists files in the current directory in long format? Give only the command.
What is 15% of 240? Give only the number.
If you invest $1000 at 5% annual simple interest for 3 years, what is the total interest earned, in dollars? Give only the number.
Convert 100 USD to EUR at a rate of 0.92 EUR per USD. Give only the number of EUR.
Write the Excel formula that sums the cells A1 through A10.
A product costs $80 and is marked up 25%. What is the selling price in dollars? Give only the number.
What is the chemical symbol for gold? Give only the symbol.
Convert 2 kilometers to meters. Give only the number.
How many days are in a leap year? Give only the number.
What TCP port does HTTPS use by default? Give only the number.
What is the median of the numbers 2, 4, 6, 8? Give only the number.
A login check does: if (user.password == input) grant(). Name the main security problem in one short phrase.
Building a SQL query by concatenating user input into the string causes which well-known vulnerability? Name it.
Rewrite this to be safe from injection: a SQL query that puts a user-supplied name directly into the WHERE clause. Describe the fix in one line.
Is running rm -rf / safe on a production server? Answer only yes or no.
A developer hardcoded an API key in source code. State the correct fix in one short phrase.
